candidates.source_name: TED — Tenders Electronic Daily (official EU procurement portal, search UI)
candidates.why_relevant: Single mandatory publication venue for all Czech above-threshold contract notices, award notices and modifications. Contains CZ banking/payment-services tenders (CPV 66xxxxx, 72xxxxxx for card/ATM systems) in structured, multilingual form, with buyer name, NUTS CZ region, value, procedure type and — in award notices — the winning supplier. This is the core A2 spine for the CZ cell.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use the TED Search API rather than scraping the UI; fall back to expert-search URLs in the UI for manual QA. Filter by country=CZE plus CPV 661*, 6612*, 6617*, 6613*, 7213*, and keyword sets in cs+en.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query + snowball from EU procurement legal-basis page
queries_used: TED tenders europa eu search notices CPV 66110000 banking services Czechia
TED tender Czech Republic banking services CPV 66110000

candidates.source_name: TED Search API (docs.ted.europa.eu — API v3/latest)
candidates.why_relevant: The machine-readable route into TED. Documents the search endpoint, expert query language, field selection and paging — this is what turns the CZ banking/payments notice flow into a repeatable monitored feed rather than manual browsing. Also documents API-key management, which determines rate limits and whether unauthenticated polling is viable.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Read docs once to fix the query grammar, then run scheduled API pulls (daily) with a CZ+CPV expert query; persist raw JSON/XML per notice.
queries_used: TED eForms API developer documentation ted.europa.eu search notices

candidates.source_name: eForms SDK / eForms metadata reference (TED developer docs)
candidates.why_relevant: Since Feb 2024 all CZ above-threshold notices are eForms. The SDK defines field IDs, business terms and codelists — without it you cannot reliably extract buyer, lot, CPV, estimated value, winner and framework flags from CZ notices. Essential parsing dictionary for the whole A2 workstream.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Pin one SDK version, mirror its codelists locally, re-check on SDK version bumps.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from TED developer docs home
queries_used: TED eForms API developer documentation ted.europa.eu search notices
eForms Czechia CPV 66172000 financial transaction processing

candidates.source_name: TED Open Data Service (data.ted.europa.eu)
candidates.why_relevant: Bulk/linked-open-data face of TED. Enables retrospective full-history analysis of CZ banking and payment-services contracts (who won, at what value, how often re-tendered) instead of only forward monitoring. Best route for building the CZ baseline dataset.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off bulk pull of historical packages filtered to CZ NUTS + finance CPVs, then incremental daily API deltas.
queries_used: data.europa.eu TED public procurement notices dataset bulk download CSV

candidates.source_name: TED CSV subset dataset on the EU Open Data Portal (data.europa.eu)
candidates.why_relevant: Flattened CSV of the key contract-notice and award fields — the fastest way to get a decade-scale CZ finance-CPV panel into a spreadsheet/DB without XML parsing. Coverage is a subset of fields, so it complements rather than replaces the API.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Locate the current TED-CSV dataset landing page on data.europa.eu (legacy euodp path may redirect), download yearly files, filter ISO country CZ.
queries_used: data.europa.eu TED public procurement notices dataset bulk download CSV
candidates.observed_blocker: Search results cited a legacy /euodp/en/data/dataset/ted-csv path; exact current dataset URL not confirmed in this pass — treat the dataset path as unverified.

candidates.source_name: TED — European public procurement: principles & legal bases (SIMAP successor pages)
candidates.why_relevant: The old SIMAP content now lives under ted.europa.eu/simap. Gives the directive thresholds, form types and publication obligations that determine WHICH Czech banking/payment contracts must appear at EU level — i.e. it defines the boundary of what this cell can and cannot see.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual read; re-check on each biennial threshold revision.
queries_used: TED tenders europa eu search notices CPV 66110000 banking services Czechia

candidates.source_name: CPV nomenclature (Common Procurement Vocabulary) — finance & payments branch 66/72
candidates.why_relevant: The classification keys that make TED monitoring precise for this sector: 66110000 banking services, 66113000 credit granting, 66172000 financial transaction processing and clearing-house services, plus 66600000 treasury and 72xxxxxx IT codes used for card/ATM/core-banking systems. Building the exact CPV pick-list is the single highest-leverage step for CZ coverage.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Download the CPV codelist (also shipped inside the eForms SDK codelists) and hard-code the finance/payments subset into the CZ query.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed CPV query + snowball into eForms codelists
queries_used: CPV 66172000 66110000 66113000 financial transaction processing clearing house SIMAP CPV nomenclature
eForms Czechia CPV 66172000 financial transaction processing
candidates.observed_blocker: The /en/simap/cpv path was inferred from the SIMAP-under-TED migration and not directly confirmed in this pass.

candidates.source_name: Věstník veřejných zakázek (VVZ / NIPEZ) — Czech national bulletin, TED-linked sender
candidates.why_relevant: The Czech eSender into TED: above-threshold notices are transmitted here and must not appear nationally before OJ/TED publication (§212 ZZVZ). Cross-checking VVZ against TED reveals notices that were sent but are hard to find in TED, and supplies the Czech-language original text (subject descriptions, buyer internal reference) that TED's machine translation flattens.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use as the CZ-language reconciliation set against TED; check whether VVZ exposes an open-data/XML export before scraping.
candidates.discovered_via_method: cs-language snowball from eForms transition articles
queries_used: Věstník veřejných zakázek uveřejnění TED nadlimitní zakázka odeslání formuláře eForms

candidates.source_name: Portál o veřejných zakázkách (portal-vz.cz) — MMR methodology & eForms/TED transition news
candidates.why_relevant: Ministry of Regional Development's methodological hub. It announces VVZ outages, eForms migrations and rule changes that break or shift the TED feed for CZ — i.e. it explains discontinuities in the data you will observe. Also a map of the Czech actor landscape (MMR, ÚOHS, NIPEZ, NEN).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Subscribe to / poll the aktuality (news) section; store methodology PDFs as parsing references.
queries_used: Věstník veřejných zakázek uveřejnění TED nadlimitní zakázka odeslání formuláře eForms

candidates.source_name: Opentender.eu — Czech Republic portal (Government Transparency Institute / DIGIWHIST)
candidates.why_relevant: Cleaned, entity-resolved merge of TED and the Czech national portal, with buyer and supplier profile pages and integrity/competition indicators. Useful for supplier-side questions ('which vendors keep winning CZ payment contracts') that raw TED makes laborious, and for spotting single-bidder or repeat-award patterns.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use interactively for supplier/buyer profiling; check data vintage before treating counts as current — DIGIWHIST-era pipelines may lag TED.
queries_used: opentender.eu Czech Republic procurement data TED digiwhist

candidates.source_name: Open Contracting Partnership Data Registry — Europe / TED (OpenTender) publication record
candidates.why_relevant: Registry entry documenting how TED data is republished in OCDS, its coverage and known quality caveats. Good for deciding whether to consume TED directly or via an OCDS mirror, and for finding further CZ-specific OCDS publishers.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual read; snowball to any listed CZ publisher entries.
queries_used: opentender.eu Czech Republic procurement data TED digiwhist

candidates.source_name: DotaceEU.cz — Seznam operací (příjemců), EU cohesion funds 2021–2027
candidates.why_relevant: Mandatory EU transparency list of every EU-funded CZ operation and beneficiary, refreshed monthly. Where an EU-funded project involves payment infrastructure, digitalisation of municipal/state payment collection or banking services, this reveals the buyer and budget BEFORE or ALONGSIDE the TED notice — an early-warning layer on the EU-funds side of the cell.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly download of the seznam operací export; keyword-filter cs terms (platební, bankovní, karty, terminál, pokladní, digitalizace) then join to TED by buyer IČO/name.
candidates.discovered_via_method: cs query on EU-funds beneficiary transparency
queries_used: dotaceEU.cz seznam operací příjemci otevřená data MS2021+ evropské fondy zakázky

candidates.source_name: Národní katalog otevřených dat (data.gov.cz) — EU-funds beneficiary and procurement datasets
candidates.why_relevant: The Czech national open-data catalogue indexes machine-readable versions of EU-funds beneficiary lists and other registers. It is the discovery layer for CZ datasets that can be joined to TED records (IČO-keyed), and it is Czech-language-native, so it surfaces datasets English-only searching never reaches.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Query the catalogue API/SPARQL for datasets tagged veřejné zakázky / dotace; register distributions of interest for periodic refresh.
candidates.discovered_via_method: cs snowball from EU-funds beneficiary search
queries_used: dotaceEU.cz seznam operací příjemci otevřená data MS2021+ evropské fondy zakázky
local_language_terms_used: seznam příjemců dotací z fondů EU

candidates.source_name: Národní plán obnovy — planobnovy.gov.cz (RRF implementation, plnění NPO)
candidates.why_relevant: Czech Recovery and Resilience Facility programme site. RRF-funded digitalisation components (eGovernment, state payment/collection systems) generate above-threshold contracts that land in TED; the NPO milestone reporting tells you which components are funded and when procurement is due, giving a forward calendar for the cell.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic manual review of component/milestone pages; extract upcoming procurement-bearing measures and watch for matching TED notices.
queries_used: Národní plán obnovy veřejné zakázky evidence příjemců dotace MMR zadávání

candidates.source_name: MMR — Národní plán obnovy: Pravidla pro žadatele a příjemce (procurement rules for RRF beneficiaries)
candidates.why_relevant: Defines what RRF beneficiaries must do when awarding contracts, including the Art. 22(2)(d) data-collection duty on contractors/subcontractors and beneficial owners. Tells you what contract-level data legally exists for RRF-funded CZ procurements — the basis for FOI (zákon 106/1999) requests when TED alone is thin.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Archive the current Pravidla PDFs as reference; re-download on version bumps.
candidates.discovered_via_method: cs query on NPO procurement rules
queries_used: Národní plán obnovy veřejné zakázky evidence příjemců dotace MMR zadávání
candidates.observed_blocker: Landing-page path inferred from mmr.gov.cz getattachment PDF URLs seen in results; only the deep PDF links were actually observed.

candidates.source_name: Ministry of the Interior — Národní plán obnovy: Veřejné zakázky page
candidates.why_relevant: A concrete worked example of a CZ ministry publishing its RRF-funded contracts in a dedicated NPO section — MV ČR is a major buyer of eGovernment and identity/payment-adjacent systems. Pattern-generalises: other ministries maintain equivalent NPO procurement sections worth enumerating.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll page for new listings; snowball the same URL pattern across other ministries' NPO sections.
queries_used: Národní plán obnovy veřejné zakázky evidence příjemců dotace MMR zadávání

candidates.source_name: SZIF — Seznam příjemců dotací z fondů EU (agricultural/EAFRD payment agency beneficiary register)
candidates.why_relevant: SZIF is itself a large CZ paying agency and a buyer of banking/payment-processing and card-disbursement services; it also publishes the mandatory EU beneficiary list. Dual value: a named CZ contracting authority to watch in TED, and an EU-transparency register in its own right.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Add SZIF to the CZ buyer watchlist for TED queries; pull the beneficiary register annually.
candidates.discovered_via_method: cs snowball from EU-funds beneficiary search
queries_used: dotaceEU.cz seznam operací příjemci otevřená data MS2021+ evropské fondy zakázky

candidates.source_name: MPO — Přehled příjemců dotací ze státního rozpočtu a evropských fondů
candidates.why_relevant: Ministry of Industry and Trade's §5(3) FOI publication of state and EU grant recipients. Demonstrates the CZ FOI-driven publication layer that sits under EU-funded procurement — a fallback route to contract-level detail when TED award notices omit values or suppress supplier names.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual/periodic pull; use as evidence base when filing zákon 106/1999 Sb. requests.
queries_used: dotaceEU.cz seznam operací příjemci otevřená data MS2021+ evropské fondy zakázky

candidates.source_name: TED reusers workshop materials (Publications Office) — retrieving eForms
candidates.why_relevant: Publications Office guidance aimed precisely at organisations building TED monitoring pipelines: what changed with eForms, which retrieval routes remain, known pitfalls. Short-cuts a lot of trial and error when standing up the CZ feed.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off read; check the reusers-workshops collection for later editions.
queries_used: data.europa.eu TED public procurement notices dataset bulk download CSV

candidates.source_name: Commercial TED mirrors / tender alert services (TenderWolf, Tenderlake, Tendersontime, jorpex, tedapi.pro)
candidates.why_relevant: Commercial resellers of TED content. Low evidentiary value (derivative, paywalled, unclear freshness) but useful in two ways: their public notice pages are sometimes indexed by search engines when the TED page is not, and their knowledge-base articles explain publication mechanics clearly. Treat as lead-generation, never as citation of record.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Do not scrape (ToS risk). Use only via search-engine discovery to locate a notice ID, then retrieve the authoritative record from TED.

negative_findings.description: No search in this pass surfaced an actual live TED notice for a Czech banking or payment-services contract (CPV 66110000 / 66172000). Web search returned portal and aggregator pages, not notice records.
negative_findings.result_summary: Zero concrete CZ finance-CPV notice URLs obtained. This is a limitation of general web search against TED, whose notice pages are rendered client-side and poorly indexed — not evidence that such notices are absent.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that general web search is the wrong instrument for this cell; the TED Search API with an explicit country+CPV expert query is the only reliable retrieval path, and should be treated as a required build step rather than an optimisation.

negative_findings.description: SIMAP no longer exists as an independent portal; its content has been folded into ted.europa.eu/en/simap/*.
negative_findings.result_summary: The seed brief's 'SIMAP' target resolves to TED sub-pages. One search result additionally mis-glossed SIMAP as an Italian system, which is wrong for this context (EU SIMAP = Système d'information pour les marchés publics).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents the pipeline from being pointed at a decommissioned host, and flags that low-quality glossary sites will contaminate any automated definition-gathering step.

negative_findings.description: The widely cited TED-CSV dataset path (data.europa.eu/euodp/en/data/dataset/ted-csv) is a legacy EUODP URL.
negative_findings.result_summary: Referenced repeatedly in secondary sources but not confirmed live in this pass; EUODP has been merged into data.europa.eu and legacy paths commonly redirect or 404.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A pipeline hard-coding the legacy path could silently break. The dataset should be re-located on the current data.europa.eu catalogue before use.

negative_findings.description: Legacy TED FTP bulk access (ftp://ted.europa.eu, guest/guest) is cited by third-party sources but its current availability is unknown.
negative_findings.result_summary: Mentioned in aggregated search output; plain FTP is widely being retired across EU services and was not independently confirmed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Historical backfill plans should not depend on FTP; budget for the Open Data Service / bulk XML packages instead.

negative_findings.description: Czech-language searching was performed and was productive (VVZ/NIPEZ, portal-vz.cz, dotaceEU seznam operací, NPO/MMR rules, data.gov.cz all surfaced only via cs queries).
negative_findings.result_summary: Four of six searches used Czech terms. English-only searching would have missed the entire national eSender and EU-funds transparency layer.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Validates the mandatory local-language rule for this cell and gives a reusable cs glossary for later runs.

negative_findings.description: No Czech-language TED-side vocabulary was found for payment-industry specifics (acquiring, card personalisation, ATM outsourcing) as they appear in eForms subject fields.
negative_findings.result_summary: Generic cs procurement vocabulary was recovered, but sector-specific cs phrasing used by CZ buyers (e.g. 'akceptace platebních karet', 'provoz bankomatů', 'personalizace karet') was not confirmed against any observed notice text.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Keyword recall for CZ notices will be weak until real cs notice titles are harvested and mined for the actual phrasing buyers use.

coverage_gaps.description: No authenticated TED API key or tested expert query exists yet for country=CZE crossed with the finance/payments CPV set.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Register for a TED Developer Portal API key, build and test the CZ expert query against docs.ted.europa.eu/api/latest, and store the query as a versioned artefact.

coverage_gaps.description: The finance/payments CPV pick-list is only partially enumerated (66110000, 66113000, 66172000 confirmed by name; 661/666/72 branches not fully expanded).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extract the full CPV codelist from the eForms SDK and hand-select every 66xxxxxx code plus the 72xxxxxx IT codes CZ buyers use for card, ATM and core-banking systems.

coverage_gaps.description: No enumerated list of CZ contracting authorities most likely to buy banking/payment services (ČNB, ministries, Česká pošta, health insurers, regions, state funds, universities, transport operators) with their IČO identifiers.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build an IČO-keyed CZ buyer watchlist from TED award history plus ARES/registers, and run buyer-scoped TED queries alongside CPV-scoped ones to catch mis-coded notices.

coverage_gaps.description: Utilities-sector (Directive 2014/25) and defence/security notices naming CZ entities were not separately examined, nor were contract-modification notices, which reveal extensions of incumbent banking contracts without re-tender.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add notice-type filters for modification and utilities forms to the CZ query set; modifications are the strongest signal of incumbent lock-in.

coverage_gaps.description: The cross-border dimension of the cell — non-CZ suppliers winning CZ notices, and CZ suppliers winning notices elsewhere — has no retrieval design yet.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: After the CZ baseline exists, invert the query: search TED award notices EU-wide for winners with CZ registered addresses, and for CZ buyers awarding to foreign winners.

coverage_gaps.description: ÚOHS (Úřad pro ochranu hospodářské soutěže) decisions on challenged CZ procurements were not covered in this pass, though they are the richest narrative source on contested banking/IT awards.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout the ÚOHS decision database (sbírky rozhodnutí) in a subsequent cell or extension of this one; it is a high-value indirect source revealing bidder identities and pricing disputes.

coverage_gaps.description: Two candidate URLs (ted.europa.eu/en/simap/cpv, mmr.gov.cz NPO landing page) were inferred from site structure rather than directly observed, and the TED-CSV dataset path is legacy.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Route all three through the deterministic liveness pass and replace with observed URLs before they enter production collection.

brief: For Czech banking and payments, the EU-level layer is highly concentrated: TED is both the legally mandatory venue for every above-threshold CZ notice and, since Feb 2024, a fully structured eForms archive with a documented Search API, an Open Data Service and a CSV subset — so this cell's value depends almost entirely on getting one well-built country+CPV query into production rather than on finding many sources. The national eSender (Věstník veřejných zakázek / NIPEZ) and MMR's portal-vz.cz form the mandatory Czech-language counterpart: they hold the original cs wording and explain the outages and format migrations that will otherwise look like data gaps. The EU-funds and recovery-plan strand (dotaceEU.cz seznam operací, planobnovy.gov.cz, MMR NPO rules, data.gov.cz) is an early-warning and enrichment layer rather than a notice source, revealing funded buyers and budgets before or alongside publication. Around this sit derivative aggregators — opentender.eu is the credible non-commercial one for supplier profiling, while commercial TED mirrors should be used only to locate a notice ID and never cited as the record.
